status: implemented and registered locally; provider tool approval still denies delivery
transport: MCP-shaped JSON-RPC over stdio; JSON fixture or SQLite/WAL store selectable
identity: fixed at process start in this fixture; no production authentication
wake_behavior: room_wait polls durable room events for at most 2000ms; it does not wake an idle provider and idle wake remains unverified
known_limitations: The JSON fixture store is not a production cross-process write-lock; M1 should move authority to SQLite WAL or an equivalent transactional store.
